Capsules: Adults may take 2 capsules per serving.

Gummies: Adults may take 2 gummies per serving.

Gel: Take 1–2 tablespoons (15–30ml) per day. Mix into smoothies, juices, water, oatmeal, or your favorite recipes. One 8oz jar contains 16 servings.

As with any dietary supplement, consult your physician before use if you are pregnant, nursing, have or suspect a medical condition, or are taking any medications.
